Messages.Author: Kevin M.
Messages.Body:
LSJ,

Sterile:
Sterile vampires cannot take actions to put other vampires in play.

1. Is Dual Form [PRO] an action to create a vampire, and would
therefore be prohibited by a sterile vampire? I think it clearly is.

Dual Form
2 blood
+1 stealth action.
[pro] n/a
[PRO] This acting vampire's capacity is reduced by 1. Put this card
in play, tapped. It becomes a non-unique vampire with the same clan,
capacity and Disciplines as the acting vampire. You may move up to
2 blood from the acting vampire to this vampire. If either minion
leaves the ready region, the other is burned.

2. How about The Eternal Mask [SER]? I think it, too, clearly is.

The Eternal Mask
1 blood
+1 stealth action.
[ser] n/a
[SER] Put this card on this vampire and move a unique vampire from
any ash heap to your ready region with any amount of blood from this
acting vampire. The minion with this card cannot take actions, block,
play reaction cards or vote. You may burn this card and the chosen
vampire during any untap phase.

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
On Nov 1, 10:10 am, Robert Scythe <tbel...@gmail.com> wrote:

> Well, then Chain of Command also falls into this category.

I suppose I should quote it for reference:

Chain of Command
+1 stealth action.
[dom] Put X younger vampires from your uncontrolled region in play
with 1 blood from the blood bank each (in addition to any blood they
already have). You cannot choose any unique vampires already in play.
Those vampires must bleed. When one of them bleeds successfully, or
when all that can bleed have, move them all to the bottom of your
crypt.
[DOM] As above, but move X+1 younger vampires.
